newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets third round of specials.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets third round of specials.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Thursday conducted a third round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money market at 3.50 percent, traders said.
They said the central bank intervened as the call loan or overnight lending rate continued to trade at the top of the bank's 3.0-3.50 percent target range.
One dealer said the call loan rate was bid at 3.55 percent with an asking price of 3.60 percent in the wake of the third round of specials.
"I think probably the biggest driver here right now is bank year-end," the dealer said. "It's also settlement day for the bills which traditionally causes a little bit of funding pressure."
Dealers said the three rounds of specials should ease upward pressure on call and the Bank of Canada was not expected to intervene with a fourth round of specials.
